assemblyai-stt-3-7.description: AssemblyAI-STT-3.7 — 32-language pre-recorded transcription with the new diarization model
assemblyai-stt-3-7.pricingNotes: AssemblyAI-STT-3.7 pre-recorded transcription is $0.21/hour plus $0.02/hour for speaker diarization, pro-rated per second with no minimum; failed transcripts are not charged. The default inclusive rate is $0.23/hour; disabling diarization subtracts the add-on. Keyterms and contextual prompting ($0.05/hour each) are not sent. Free allowances, discounts, taxes and credits are excluded. Timing estimates are borrowed from Universal-3.5 Pro and remain provisional.

limits.notes: AssemblyAI allows larger remote URLs than upload API submissions. The current CLI uploads first, so effectiveBytes tracks the smaller upload cap.

lifecycle.notes: Deprecated by AssemblyAI on 2026-11-17 with retirement to be announced (at least 90 days' notice); requests naming it run on Universal-3.5 Pro until retirement, then route to assemblyai-stt-3-7. It stays selectable by explicit name because episode publishing pins it.
